title: Toward Realistic Energy Forecasting: A Delay-Enhanced Fractional-Order Supply-Demand Model
summary: In order to represent the complex dynamics of contemporary energy systems, a novel fractional-order energy supply-demand model with time delay is presented in this investigation. The fractional model, compared to traditional integer-order models, naturally accommodates for memory and genetic effects, and the incorporation of delay component takes into account unavoidable lags in energy production, transmission, and consumption.
